question:
Identify the figure given in the options that when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0a58cd24c02a6e708aebff67340ee157555d2a645743d26abfa3c7b9d8a51e4.png]
solution: The logic followed here is: 1) The whole element is rotated 90º anticlockwise. 2) The number of square element is decreasing subsequently. 3) The smallest triangle element is alternately shaded.
